STANDING REAL ASSETS: the supply-side plane gains (physics-derived, cross-net, outside any noise: L12 0.0777->0.0644, L14 0.0901->0.0711), the collective-mode theory + tracker + instruments, the kappa3^2 plane-half, the deploy-gated harness, the oracle 7.09e-9 proof. The correction chain is CERTIFIED at ~16% held-out; if supply were billable: raw 2.48e-8 -> adj 1.50e-8 (-16%). record.goal_path_summary: Our honesty instrument. With only two test networks, score comparisons were inside the noise (+-2.6 points) - we literally could not tell which ideas worked. We built truth data for three more networks (about 35 minutes each) and a leave-one-out grader, cutting the noise nearly in half. Every fire/no-fire decision now rests on this panel, and extending it to all ten networks is a mechanical afternoon when we want even sharper answers.
